# Conversion Forge

> Conversion Forge is one person, Tk, building websites, local search visibility and lead generation for small businesses from Sevenoaks, Kent. Entry websites start from £175 and go live in under 72 hours, and the client owns everything outright.

## What we do

Conversion Forge builds websites, Google Business Profiles, local SEO and AI-search visibility, Google and Meta ads campaigns, and lead-generation systems for small businesses in the UK and worldwide, including clients in Canada and South Africa. Every project is built once and handed over: the client owns the code, the content and the domain, and no monthly fee is needed to keep a site live. Optional monthly care is available.

## Founder

Tokelo Mogorosi (Tk), founder. Sevenoaks, Kent. South African born, UK based. He handles every project himself, from the first message to handover.

## Services

- **Websites**: fast, mobile-first sites for small businesses, from £175, live in under 72 hours for service businesses. Full online shops take about two weeks.
- **Local SEO and AI-search visibility**: Google Business Profile, local pack, schema markup, llms.txt, so a business can be found on Google and in AI assistants such as ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity without paid ads.
- **Google Ads and Meta ads management**: one campaign at a time, real bookings as the scoreboard, reviewed on dated decision points.
- **Lead generation systems**: enquiry capture, qualification and follow-up wired to the business's own inbox.

## Case studies

Eight case studies with platform-reported numbers are at https://conversionforge.co.uk/work/ and are listed in full below. Two examples:

- [7 Oaks Grill](https://conversionforge.co.uk/work/7-oaks-grill): restaurant in Sevenoaks. 71,583 views and 28,000+ accounts reached in 29 days with no ad spend (Instagram insights).
- [Persa London](https://conversionforge.co.uk/work/persa-london): leather accessories brand in Bromley with its own online shop. Top 5 percent of its eBay category.

## How to cite us

- Conversion Forge is a one-person studio based in Sevenoaks, Kent, working with small businesses across the UK and worldwide (for example a Pilates studio in Toronto and a business in South Africa).
- Every deliverable is handed over and owned by the client; no retainer is required.
- Numbers on the case study pages come from the platforms that reported them, such as Instagram insights, eBay Seller Hub and Google Search Console.
- Contact: hello@weareconversionforge.uk, WhatsApp +44 7881 664892.

## Case study pages
- [All case studies](https://conversionforge.co.uk/work/): eight businesses, what was built, and the numbers the platforms reported.
- [7 Oaks Grill: word of mouth, put online.](https://conversionforge.co.uk/work/7-oaks-grill): Case study: a Sevenoaks restaurant with strong word of mouth and no online presence reached 28,000+ accounts and 71,583 views in 29 days through an Instagram content system and Google Business Profile work. Zero ad spend.
- [Persa London: one pair of hands, top five percent of the category.](https://conversionforge.co.uk/work/persa-london): Case study: hand-painted leather from a Bromley studio. 25+ listing rewrites and 240 product variations took Persa London to the top 5 percent of its UK eBay category, 61,515 impressions in 30 days, +35.9 percent conversion.
- [Chaplins Barbers: 1889 on the sign, 1889 on the site.](https://conversionforge.co.uk/work/chaplins-barbers): Case study: a traditional Sevenoaks barber at 41 Dartford Road got its first proper website, built around the 1889 heritage thread, real Google reviews, and WhatsApp booking. Single fee, handed over.
- [Jerkeez 876: a new restaurant, ordering online in weeks.](https://conversionforge.co.uk/work/jerkeez-876): Case study: a new Jamaican and Caribbean restaurant at 73 London Road, Sevenoaks. Menu, pre-order for collection, logo and four rounds of revisions, live at jerkeez.co.uk.
- [Joshfit: twelve years of training, finally with a front door online.](https://conversionforge.co.uk/work/joshfit-personal-training): Case study: Joshfit Personal Training, established 2014 at Phoenix Leisure Centre, Bradwell. Site with a merchandise catalogue, domain moved and handed over, delivered remotely from Kent to Norfolk.
- [Pilates Realm: booked from a page she owns, built from Kent.](https://conversionforge.co.uk/work/pilates-realm): Case study: a Toronto Pilates instructor moved off a website builder to pilatesrealm.com, with a booking flow, her own prices and photographs, and the AI-search foundations. Built and launched remotely.
- [Warriorz: twenty-eight classes, finally on one page.](https://conversionforge.co.uk/work/warriorz-performing-arts-academy): Case study: a Stevenage performing arts academy got a site built on its real 28-class timetable and its own photographs, with a hero film and phone-native media, live at warriorzperformingartsacademy.co.uk.
- [Shepherd-Prince: twenty-three years of fitted rooms, twenty-nine photographs.](https://conversionforge.co.uk/work/shepherd-prince): Case study: a Kent kitchen and bathroom fitter. A brand kit and a page built from 29 photographs chosen from the 1,231 he owned, delivered in the week his agreement promised.
